about.bio: Computer Science undergraduate exploring cybersecurity, information security, Linux systems, and software engineering. Building security-focused applications, experimenting with network threat detection, and learning by breaking down how systems work.
about.extra: Vadodara, India · GSFC University · Open Source

work.title: Cybersecurity Intern
work.desc: Worked with the Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) and Incident Response Management teams. Gained practical exposure to information security operations, risk management, incident response workflows, and organizational security practices.

work.title: AI & Cybersecurity Developer
work.desc: Developing an AI-Based Network Attack Forecasting system using CICIDS2018 network traffic data. Built data preprocessing pipelines, trained and evaluated Random Forest models, performed verification on millions of network flows, and integrated the model into a Flask prediction API.

work.title: Backend Developer
work.desc: Building a Security Operations Center incident management platform. Working with Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, authentication, database architecture, and backend API development.

work.title: Independent Security Researcher
work.desc: Exploring penetration testing, network reconnaissance, web application security, SIEM, and vulnerability assessment through hands-on labs. Experimenting with Kali Linux, Burp Suite, Nmap, Wazuh, PortSwigger Academy, TryHackMe, and Hack The Box.

projects.name: NexGuard
projects.desc: AI-based network attack forecasting system using machine learning and network traffic analysis.
projects.long: NexGuard explores the application of machine learning in network security. Built around CICIDS2018 traffic data, the project includes data preprocessing, chunk-based dataset processing, Random Forest model training, performance evaluation, verification across millions of network flows, and a Flask-based prediction API.

projects.name: SOCDesk
projects.desc: A Security Operations Center incident management platform focused on security workflows and incident handling.
projects.long: SOCDesk is a security-focused application developed around SOC incident management. The backend architecture uses Express.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma ORM, with structured database models, authentication, and API development. The project is designed to explore how security operations platforms manage incidents and organize security workflows.

projects.name: SIEM Lab
projects.desc: A hands-on SIEM lab exploring centralized security monitoring, log analysis, and threat detection using Wazuh.
projects.long: An experimental security monitoring environment focused on understanding SIEM architecture, endpoint monitoring, security event collection, and centralized log analysis. Exploring Wazuh deployment, dashboard configuration, agent communication, and security monitoring workflows in Linux environments.

projects.name: Network Attack Prediction API
projects.desc: A Flask-based API exposing a trained Random Forest model for network traffic classification and attack prediction.
projects.long: A machine learning inference service built around a trained Random Forest model. Uses Python and Joblib to load the serialized model and exposes health-check and prediction endpoints through Flask. Designed to connect network traffic analysis with an accessible prediction interface.

projects.name: CampusHub
projects.desc: A Kali Linux quick-start guide focused on helping users understand and navigate their Linux security environment.
projects.long: A documentation-oriented project idea centered around Kali Linux, terminal workflows, essential security tools, and practical command-line usage. Intended to make Linux and cybersecurity tooling more approachable through structured technical documentation.

projects.name: Hyprland Environment
projects.desc: A customized Kali Linux desktop environment built around Hyprland, Waybar, Kitty, and shell customization.
projects.long: An ongoing Linux customization environment involving Hyprland window management, Waybar configuration, Zsh, Starship, Kitty terminal, custom media popup development, keyboard-driven workflows, and visual customization using Wallust.
